Title: Submit Patent Application
Scenario: Applicant submits a complete application with valid documents
Preconditions: Applicant is logged in and authorized
Input/Action: POST /patent/application with title, abstract, description, claims, inventors, uploaded_documents
Expected Result: PatentApplication created with status=Submitted; confirmation email sent; appears on applicant dashboard

Title: Submit Patent Application
Scenario: Applicant saves an incomplete application as draft
Preconditions: Applicant is logged in
Expected Result: Application saved as draft; no notification sent to PCC_ADMIN

Title: Submit Patent Application
Scenario: Unauthorized user attempts to submit
Preconditions: User is logged in without 'Applicant' role
Expected Result: Request rejected with authorization error; submission blocked

Title: Submit Patent Application
Scenario: Applicant submits incomplete application
Preconditions: Applicant is logged in
Expected Result: System highlights missing fields; application not submitted; returns to form

Title: Submit Patent Application
Scenario: Document validation fails during upload
Preconditions: Applicant is logged in
Expected Result: Error displayed for invalid document; retry upload prompted

Title: Assign Application to Director
Scenario: System auto-assigns application to Director based on expertise match
Preconditions: Application status is Submitted; eligible Directors are available
Expected Result: Application status updated to Under Review; Director notified; review timeline initiated

Title: Assign Application to Director
Scenario: PCC_ADMIN manually overrides auto-assignment
Preconditions: Application is Submitted; PCC_ADMIN is logged in
Expected Result: Application assigned to selected Director; status updated; Director notified

Title: Assign Application to Director
Scenario: No eligible Director is available
Preconditions: Application is Submitted; no Director with matching expertise has capacity
Expected Result: Assignment fails; retry scheduled; application remains Submitted

Title: Assign Application to Director
Scenario: Assignment conflict detected
Preconditions: Director already at max workload
Expected Result: Conflict flagged; manual override required; assignment not saved

Title: Review Patent Application
Scenario: Director approves a complete and valid application
Preconditions: Application is Under Review and assigned to Director
Expected Result: Application status updated to Approved; applicant notified; audit log updated

Title: Review Patent Application
Scenario: Director requests revision from applicant
Preconditions: Application is Under Review
Expected Result: Application status changed to Needs Revision; applicant notified with feedback

Title: Review Patent Application
Scenario: Director defers the review
Preconditions: Application is Under Review
Expected Result: Deferral note added; timeline extended; application remains Under Review

Title: Review Patent Application
Scenario: Review timeline is violated
Preconditions: Application has exceeded review deadline
Expected Result: Escalation logged; timeline violation recorded; PCC_ADMIN notified

Title: Revise and Resubmit Application
Scenario: Applicant addresses all feedback and resubmits within 60 days
Preconditions: Application is in Needs Revision status; within 60-day resubmission window
Expected Result: Application status changed to Resubmitted; new review cycle triggered; stakeholders notified

Title: Revise and Resubmit Application
Scenario: Applicant partially updates and saves before final resubmission
Preconditions: Application is in Needs Revision; within allowed window
Expected Result: Draft revision saved; version history maintained; no status change

Title: Revise and Resubmit Application
Scenario: Applicant attempts to resubmit after the 60-day window has expired
Preconditions: Application is in Needs Revision; 60-day deadline has passed
Expected Result: Submission rejected with date/deadline error; status changed to Expired; applicant notified

Title: Revise and Resubmit Application
Scenario: Revised application does not address the feedback
Preconditions: Application is in Needs Revision
Expected Result: System rejects revision; applicant prompted to make further edits

Title: Track Application Status
Scenario: Applicant views current status of their application
Preconditions: Applicant is logged in; application exists in the system
Expected Result: Current status, history timeline, and pending actions displayed

Title: Track Application Status
Scenario: PCC_ADMIN views status of all applications in a batch
Preconditions: PCC_ADMIN is logged in
Expected Result: Filtered and sorted list of applications with statuses displayed

Title: Track Application Status
Scenario: Applicant attempts to view another applicant's application
Preconditions: Applicant is logged in
Expected Result: Access denied with authorization error

Title: Assign Attorney
Scenario: PCC_ADMIN assigns available attorney to application
Preconditions: Application requires legal review; attorney is available
Expected Result: Attorney assigned; application updated; attorney notified

Title: Assign Attorney
Scenario: No attorney is available for assignment
Preconditions: All attorneys are at capacity
Expected Result: Assignment fails; PCC_ADMIN alerted to manually resolve

Title: Assess Application Patentability (Legal Assessment)
Scenario: Attorney completes legal assessment and marks application as patentable
Preconditions: Attorney is assigned and application is accessible
Expected Result: Legal assessment recorded; application progresses to filing stage

Title: Assess Application Patentability (Legal Assessment)
Scenario: Attorney finds significant legal conflict; application is not patentable
Preconditions: Attorney is assigned
Expected Result: Application flagged; Director and applicant notified; further action required

Title: Manage Budgets and Financial Approval
Scenario: PCC_ADMIN approves budget within threshold
Preconditions: Budget request submitted; amount is within PCC_ADMIN approval limit
Expected Result: Budget approved; financial tracking initiated; stakeholders notified

Title: Manage Budgets and Financial Approval
Scenario: Budget exceeds PCC_ADMIN threshold; escalated to Director
Preconditions: Budget request submitted; amount exceeds PCC_ADMIN authority
Expected Result: Request escalated to Director for approval

Title: Manage Budgets and Financial Approval
Scenario: Budget request denied by Director
Preconditions: Escalated budget request is under Director review
Expected Result: Budget denied; applicant and PCC_ADMIN notified; application on hold

Title: File with Patent Office / Log Official Filing
Scenario: Attorney files application with patent office and logs confirmation
Preconditions: All approvals in place
Expected Result: Filing logged; application status updated to Filed; deadline tracking initiated

Title: File with Patent Office / Log Official Filing
Scenario: Patent office rejects filing due to format error
Preconditions: Application submitted to patent office
Expected Result: Filing error logged; attorney notified to correct and refile

Title: Track Application Progress and Notifications
Scenario: System sends status-change notification to applicant automatically
Preconditions: Application status changes to a new stage
Expected Result: Notification dispatched to applicant and relevant parties; event logged in audit trail

Title: Track Application Progress and Notifications
Scenario: Notification delivery fails due to invalid email
Preconditions: Status change event triggered
Input/Action: SYSTEM_EVENT: application.status_changed with invalid email on record
Expected Result: Delivery failure logged; PCC_ADMIN alerted to update contact details

Title: Respond to Office Actions / Amend and Resubmit
Scenario: Attorney submits timely response to Office Action
Preconditions: Office Action received; within response deadline
Expected Result: Response filed; application status updated; deadline extended or closed

Title: Respond to Office Actions / Amend and Resubmit
Scenario: Response deadline passes without submission
Preconditions: Office Action response deadline exceeded
Expected Result: Application flagged as at-risk; escalation notification sent to PCC_ADMIN and Director

Title: Track and Manage Deadlines
Scenario: System sends deadline reminder 7 days before due date
Preconditions: Deadline is approaching
Expected Result: Reminder notification sent to responsible party; logged in audit trail

Title: Track and Manage Deadlines
Scenario: Deadline is missed; escalation triggered
Preconditions: Deadline has passed without action
Expected Result: Escalation created; PCC_ADMIN and Director notified; application flagged

Title: Manage Maintenance Fees and Renewals
Scenario: PCC_ADMIN processes maintenance fee payment on time
Preconditions: Maintenance fee is due; budget available
Expected Result: Payment recorded; patent renewal confirmed; next deadline scheduled

Title: Manage Maintenance Fees and Renewals
Scenario: Maintenance fee not paid before deadline
Preconditions: Fee due date has passed
Expected Result: Patent flagged for lapse; escalation notification sent; grace period window activated

Title: Withdraw Patent Application
Scenario: Applicant withdraws application before review begins
Preconditions: Application status is Submitted or Draft
Expected Result: Application status changed to Withdrawn; record locked; stakeholders notified

Title: Withdraw Patent Application
Scenario: Applicant attempts to withdraw an already-approved application
Preconditions: Application status is Approved or Filed
Expected Result: Withdrawal rejected with status error; PCC_ADMIN must authorize any late-stage withdrawal

Title: Generate Reports and Analytics Dashboards
Scenario: PCC_ADMIN generates a monthly application status report
Preconditions: PCC_ADMIN is logged in
Expected Result: PDF report generated with application counts by status; download link provided

Title: Generate Reports and Analytics Dashboards
Scenario: Director views live analytics dashboard
Preconditions: Director is logged in
Expected Result: Interactive dashboard displayed with current pipeline, pending reviews, and deadlines

Title: Generate Reports and Analytics Dashboards
Scenario: Report generation fails due to data query timeout
Preconditions: Large dataset being queried
Expected Result: Timeout error returned; user advised to narrow filter or retry

Title: Manage Co-Inventors and Inventor Agreements
Scenario: Applicant adds co-inventor and system sends agreement for e-signature
Preconditions: Application is in Draft; co-inventor email is valid
Expected Result: Co-inventor added; agreement email dispatched; application cannot be submitted until agreement is signed

Title: Manage Co-Inventors and Inventor Agreements
Scenario: Co-inventor does not sign agreement before submission deadline
Preconditions: Application ready for submission; co-inventor agreement pending
Expected Result: Submission blocked with unsigned agreement error; reminder sent to co-inventor

Title: Patent Licensing / Tech Transfer Request
Scenario: Applicant submits licensing request; committee approves and agreement is finalized
Preconditions: Patent is Granted; licensing policy exists
Expected Result: License record created; IP and financial systems updated; stakeholders notified

Title: Patent Licensing / Tech Transfer Request
Scenario: Negotiation involves confidential terms; redacted record created
Preconditions: Licensing negotiation in progress
Expected Result: Redacted record stored; accessible only to authorized roles

Title: Patent Licensing / Tech Transfer Request
Scenario: Negotiation fails; request archived
Preconditions: Licensing request submitted; negotiation rounds exhausted
Expected Result: Request archived; retry option available; no financial updates made

Title: Appeal Against Rejection
Scenario: Applicant files appeal within time limit; Director upholds and remands for amendment
Preconditions: Application is Rejected; appeal window is open
Expected Result: Appeal logged; Director reviews; decision to remand routes application to attorney

Title: Appeal Against Rejection
Scenario: Director modifies the original decision upon appeal
Preconditions: Appeal is under review by Director
Expected Result: Application status updated per modified decision; applicant notified

Title: Appeal Against Rejection
Scenario: Appeal submitted after the appeal period has expired
Preconditions: Rejection is recorded; appeal window has closed
Expected Result: Appeal rejected with time-expiry error; process closed

Title: Search Prior Art
Scenario: Applicant searches prior art and attaches relevant references to the application
Preconditions: Application is in Draft or Under Review; database is accessible
Expected Result: Ranked search results returned; selected references attached to application; session logged

Title: Search Prior Art
Scenario: No results found; system suggests keyword refinements
Preconditions: Search performed with narrow or niche keywords
Expected Result: Empty results with keyword expansion suggestions displayed; user can refine and retry

Title: Search Prior Art
Scenario: Database query fails due to external service unavailability
Preconditions: Search initiated; external patent database is down
Expected Result: Error message displayed; session ends gracefully; retry option shown

Title: Manage Document Versions
Scenario: Applicant uploads a new version of the patent abstract; history maintained
Preconditions: Application is active; applicant has edit access
Expected Result: New version saved; previous version archived; version history updated; stakeholders notified

Title: Manage Document Versions
Scenario: User views version history and compares two versions
Preconditions: At least two document versions exist
Expected Result: Version comparison view displayed with tracked changes highlighted

Title: Manage Document Versions
Scenario: Uploaded document fails virus scan
Preconditions: New version upload initiated
Expected Result: Upload blocked; virus scan failure error shown; previous version remains current; notification sent

Title: Manage Document Versions
Scenario: Version conflict detected between simultaneous uploads
Preconditions: Two users upload a new version at the same time
Expected Result: Conflict detected; merge process initiated; neither version automatically published until resolved
